description: Editable registry of public sources that future Relay tooling may review. An empty feed_url means a reliable public feed has not yet been confirmed.

sources.name: Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency
sources.notes: Official advisories and alerts, with special value when essential services or actively exploited vulnerabilities are involved.

sources.name: U.S. Geological Survey Earthquake Hazards Program
sources.notes: Official significant-earthquake feed. Future scoring should consider location, magnitude, damage, and population exposure.

sources.name: National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration
sources.notes: Official weather, climate, ocean, and hazard information. Confirm the appropriate public feed before automated ingestion.

sources.name: U.S. Food and Drug Administration Recalls
sources.notes: Official recalls, market withdrawals, and safety alerts. Prioritize broad distribution, severe hazards, and expanding recalls.

sources.name: U.S. Department of Agriculture
sources.notes: Official agricultural news, reports, policy, and food-system information.

sources.name: Canary Media
sources.notes: Independent reporting focused on energy systems, utilities, electrification, and the grid.

sources.name: FreightWaves
sources.notes: Trade reporting on trucking, rail, ports, air cargo, freight markets, and logistics.

sources.name: Supply Chain Dive
sources.notes: Trade reporting on sourcing, logistics, manufacturing, procurement, and supply-chain risk.

sources.name: SecurityWeek
sources.notes: Cybersecurity reporting with useful coverage of critical infrastructure, vulnerabilities, and threat activity.

sources.name: Inside Climate News
sources.notes: Nonprofit reporting on climate, energy, environmental health, infrastructure, and regulation.
